originalTitle: Oil extends gains as Middle East supply concerns persist
summary: Oil rose after Iranian officials were reportedly pessimistic over a deal before U.S. midterm elections.
content:
Oil rose Tuesday, extending gains for a second day, as worries over the Mideast conflict continuing for longer take hold, even as efforts to reduce tensions are reportedly underway.

Futures for international benchmark Brent crude for November delivery gained 1.22% to $106.56 a barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures advanced over 1% to $93.57 per barrel.

The U.S. and Iran are talking separately to mediators as part of renewed efforts to end the conflict. Citing Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, Al Jazeera reported that Tehran held indirect talks with the U.S. via Qatari mediators in New York.

Progress in talks will be a main focus for markets, as regional mediators push for ceasefire negotiations, said Mahmoud Mashal, senior market analyst of VT Markets Dubai, adding that any meaningful progress could drive crude lower.

That said, concerns over energy infrastructure and flows in the region continue to linger due to renewed tensions between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis, Mashal said.

The Strait of Hormuz, a crucial waterway that saw 20% of the world's oil supply transit through it prior to the war, remains closely watched.

Trump on Saturday had rejected Tehran's conditional proposal for reopening the strait, telling aides that he expects to resume bombing Iran following the midterm elections in November.
chineseTitle: 由于中东供应担忧持续存在，油价延续涨势
chineseSummary: 据报道，伊朗官员对美国中期选举前的协议表示悲观，油价上涨。
chineseContent:
油价周二上涨，连续第二天延续涨势，因为尽管据报道正在努力缓解紧张局势，但对中东冲突持续更长时间的担忧依然存在。

11 月交割的国际基准布伦特原油期货上涨 1.22%，至每桶 106.56 美元。美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨逾 1%，至每桶 93.57 美元。

美国和伊朗正在分别与调解人进行对话，作为结束冲突的新努力的一部分。半岛电视台援引伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇的话报道称，德黑兰通过卡塔尔调解人在纽约与美国进行了间接会谈。

VT Markets Dubai 高级市场分析师马哈茂德·马沙尔 (Mahmoud Mashal) 表示，随着地区调解人推动停火谈判，谈判进展将成为市场关注的焦点，并补充称任何有意义的进展都可能推动原油价格走低。

马沙尔表示，尽管如此，由于沙特阿拉伯和胡塞武装之间的紧张局势再度升级，对该地区能源基础设施和流动的担忧仍然挥之不去。

霍尔木兹海峡是一条重要的水道，战前全球 20% 的石油供应均经过该海峡，目前仍受到密切关注。

特朗普周六拒绝了德黑兰关于重新开放海峡的有条件提议，并告诉助手，他预计将在 11 月中期选举后恢复轰炸伊朗。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
